items.title: James "Sing" Miller Interview, 1971-01-17
items.q: No, I played with Sheik in 41. Uh-huh. Cotton Club.

ctx.x: What, just, you met him on a job or?
No, I played with Sheik in 41. Uh-huh. Cotton Club. What did you play there? Yeah, she had Albert DeLone and his brother playing Saints Ball with him there.
And who else was playing? I don't remember. Different fellas and Schmell.
